notes.title: ✨A Tick Tock: A Tale for Two Celebration ✨
notes.content:
We have so many things to celebrate with you! 

[list]
[*]Tick Tock: A Tale for Two is now verified for Steam Deck 🎮
[*]Our debut game turned 5 years old this year🕯️🕯️🕯️🕯️🕯️
[*]Together you have given Amalie approximately 65 million minutes of your time 🕰️ That’s 3900 million seconds, 1083333,3333 hours, or 4513 days - THANK YOU! (We don’t know who appreciates it more, us or Amalie)
[/list]

So if you have been waiting to play Tick Tock: A Tale for Two on your Steam Deck, it’s now ready for you! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/790740/Tick_Tock_A_Tale_for_Two/

We’re also excited about our next, single-player, game Miniatures that will be released later this year. You might recognize the same eerie vibe in Miniatures, but the rest of the game is a unique experience. If you’ve already played Tick Tock: A Tale for Two and are waiting for something new, check out the gameplay trailer 🪛🦎🦋🐚:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures/ 

~The Others

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
Dear celebratory souls!

We're closing our studio for the Christmas holidays and we're looking forward to be back again next year with new energy ❄️

A short update on what is happening at the end of this year and early next year: 

[list]
[*]We're working on updating Tick Tock: A Tale for Two so it works perfectly on the Steam Deck ✅
[*]Tick Tock: A Tale for Two is 50% off over the holidays (until January 4th) ✅
[*]We've finished two out of four stories of our new (single-player game) Miniatures, a third is almost done and the fourth is taking its first steps! ✅
[/list]

Happy holidays from us and our two games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/790740/Tick_Tock_A_Tale_for_Two/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2428840/Miniatures/

See you in the new year!

~ The Others

notes.title: Traditional Chinese and Korean update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/b58499f0f2fa5e565cabc2ee1b908c640922bfa7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/b5a9097bfafe07f51b74626d3e93831ad0cf6a82.png[/img]

Tick Tock: A Tale for Two is now available in Traditional Chinese and Korean!

We’d like to thank all our players who’ve embarked on this adventure with us, and hope this update finds new adventurers who want to solve puzzles together 🕵️🕵️

And remember, Tick Tock: A Tale for Two is still half price until the 9th of July!

Oh and we were way too excited and busy with the language update to remember to share these news… BUT: We won two awards at the Danish Games Awards (Spilprisen) a little while ago! The awards were for: Best Debut & Best Emergent Experience 🤗

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/ad601f21a90b2d3b7db3001f87c4fc1e4211595c.jpg[/img]

Sending happy summer vibes to all of you from a sunny Denmark ☀️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/790740/Tick_Tock_A_Tale_for_Two/ 

PS. The Google Play update with these new languages is delayed due to technical issues, we’re working on this and will let you know when it’s live! But you can cross-play with Nintendo Switch and iPhone/iPads. 

~ Mira & Tanja

tags.feature: Tick Tock: A Tale for Two is now available in Traditional Chinese and Korean!

notes.title: Japanese and Swedish language update - out on the 5th of December!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31922549/78a18d800484aa2e71e95cbe57e220c28fd53994.png[/img]

Brace yourself for the soon-to-come language update for Tick Tock: A Tale for Two! On the 5th of December, it will finally be possible to delve into the mysteries of this uncanny clock-world in Japanese as well as in Swedish. So whether you find yourself in the chilly, northern parts of Scandinavia or in the eastern islands of Asia, get ready for an intense co-op experience with your friends and loved ones.

Tick Tock: A Tale for Two will also be released on the Nintendo Switch on the very same date, so get ready for even more cross-play options!

~ Mira & Tanja

notes.title: 🌞The Spanish and Portuguese (Brazil) Update is Here🌞
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hUFJBNR.gif[/img]

We’ve added a Spanish and Portuguese (Brazil) version of the game, just in time for summer in our part of the world 🌸 We hope you’ll enjoy this update!

Thank you all for your support and we are so happy to see that Tick Tock: A Tale for Two is played in so many parts of the world - keep on cooperating 💬🗨️

Besides implementing and testing the two new languages we’ve also:
[list]
[*] Fixed a few shader issues in the Mac version
[*] Tweaked some animations
[*] Corrected a spelling mistake in the Danish version
[*] Optimized the game more
[/list]
We’ll get back to working on some more languages now, have an amazing Steam Summer 🙌 

~ Mira & Tanja

notes.title: Chinese Language Update! First Patch Notes!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/96bbe003ccae89daa45698e470cfde171cbba4e8.gif[/img]

We are so excited that we have added Chinese as one of our in game languages and are so happy that our Chinese speaking players can delve into Tick Tock and experience the game in their native language 😍 Thank you for letting us know about some inaccuracies in the language format, we have now updated everything and hope that the game runs smooth for all our Chinese players 🤞 We are hoping to add more languages very soon. Watch this space! 

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] A brand new language UI to make room for some cool upcoming languages that are currently being tested
[*] More reactive UI interactions
[*] Fixed a bug where collectable items would remain after being used/not show up properly in the UI
[*] Fixed a bug when entering a building and the back button wouldn’t show up
[*] Fixed a bug where exiting and entering a room would delete some sprites
[*] Optimizing the game to prevent any remaining crashes - mostly dealing with memory issues here
[*] Fixed text formatting errors that occurred in certain translations
[*] Reworked Simplified Chinese translation + added Chinese logo of the game
[*] Small changes to German translation to fit the style
[/list]

~ Mira & Tanja

notes.title: 6days left to get a free key for your player 2! Plus new languages coming soon 🗣
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/b9c9513494adccbd0704d15f38267a71434c5cb6.png[/img]
It has been some crazy days after releasing Tick Tock: A Tale for Two. The game is being played and shared all around the globe and we are over the moon! 🙌 Thank you to all of you who have been playing the game, done entertaining streams and left wonderful reviews 💕

We are super excited to have been on the Steam frontpage over the weekend (and still are!) and of being placed in the top 10 in the paid puzzle and adventure categories on mobile in several countries 😍😭
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31922549/01efd3d68cd0bd4bb6f1d9b6a2335fed3df5d075.gif[/img]
[h1]More languages[/h1]
We are seeing great interest in getting the game translated into more languages and we are now working on getting the following language versions ready as soon as possible:

[b]In the next update[/b]
[list]
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] French [/list]

[b]Translation just begun[/b]
[list]
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Spanish[/list]
[h1]Crashes[/h1]
We've had reports of crashes from some players and are working to fix that asap!

[h1]BUY 1 GET ONE FREE[/h1]
If you have Tick Tock on your wishlist, you can buy a copy now and get a second key for player 2! This offer is only good until March 17th so don't miss out.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/790740/Tick_Tock_A_Tale_for_Two/

Happy adventuring! 
~Mira and Tanja
